Enum Class Compass

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<Compass>
iscteiul.ista.battleship.Compass
All Implemented Interfaces:
java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Comparable<Compass>, java.lang.constant.Constable
public enum Compass extends java.lang.Enum<Compass>
Defines ship bearings and their lowercase command characters. West uses o, from the Portuguese word oeste.
